verdict.rationale: ROS 2's documented features (parameters, launch system, CLI tools) operate within a single robot/graph and there is no evidence of a fleet-wide mechanism to push configuration changes across many separate robots with per-group targeting; ROS 2 domains/namespaces are not shown to support this use case. Missing for 10: any fleet-management console or multi-robot targeting/grouping mechanism, evidence of pushing config to many robots simultaneously.
